items.title: Nvidia reports impressive Q2 earnings as AI boom rolls on
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) reported another strong earnings report on Wednesday after the closing bell. Adjusted earnings per share (EPS) came in at $2.22 (compared to analyst estimates of $2.09), and revenue came in at $96.2B billion (compared to analyst estimates of $92.38 billion). Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton and Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley take a closer look at the breaking numbers.

items.title: Rivian Automotive vs. Tesla: Which Electric Vehicle Stock Is a Better Investment in 2026?
items.summary: Rivian bleeds cash while scaling production; Tesla prints billions despite slowing revenue. The valuation gap between them tells an entirely different story.

items.title: Nvidia doubles revenue, forecasts even more AI spending
items.summary: AI juggernaut Nvidia on Wednesday reported quarterly revenue of $96.2 billion, more than double from a year earlier, as the world's most valuable company beat Wall Street expectations and forecast even stronger sales ahead.Nvidia told investors to expect about $108 billion in revenue in the current quarter, well ahead of Wall Street forecasts and a signal that the company sees no near-term slowdown in AI spending.

items.title: Nvidia Rallies On Major Amazon Contract, Fiscal Q2 Beat-And-Raise Report
items.summary: Nvidia beat expectations for its fiscal Q2 and with its sales outlook. Nvidia stock rose after wavering after the report.

items.title: Amazon and Nvidia expand AI partnership with 2 million GPUs
items.summary: Investing.com -- Amazon Web Services and Nvidia announced today an expansion of their partnership to address growing demand for AI infrastructure. The companies plan to deploy 2 million additional Nvidia GPUs across AWS's global infrastructure in 2027-2028.

items.title: Investors Find More to Like on Nvidia’s Earnings Call
items.summary: After a tepid inital reaction, investors like what they're hearing on Nvidia's earnings call. CFO Colette Kress told analysts that the chip-maker projects 70% revenue growth in fiscal-year 2028, and that Amazon's AWS is deploying an additional 2 million Nvidia GPUs in the coming years.

items.title: Nvidia Announces Expanded Amazon Partnership on Earnings Call
items.summary: Amazon's AWS division "is deploying an addition two million GPUs starting this quarter through the second of FY29," Nvidia CFO Colette Kress said on a conference call after the chip giant's earnings report this afternoon.

items.title: Amazon to Buy 2 Million Nvidia Chips for Data Center Build-Out
items.summary: Amazon.com Inc. will add an additional 2 million Nvidia Corp. graphics processing units to its data center fleet in the next two years, a sign that the company remains committed to the AI hardware leader’s products despite its own competitive chipmaking efforts.
